description: A vehicle USD on 4 ANCF FEM tires driving on implicit-MPM sand (scenario 3 + SolverImplicitMPM). run-examples.sh asks which vehicle USD to load (default: the Sherp; see 03_vehicle_ancf_tires). Sand bed 12x6x0.4 m, voxel 0.05, 2 ppc/axis, the whole bed simulated every step; only the 4 tire meshes are MPM colliders; sand reaction enters the tread nodes via node_f_ext_persistent. For the x10 Sherp a bed of 6 3 0.25 at voxel 0.035 is the same relative size. --sand-size 4 3 0.3 for a quick stability check. kn / kd / pcg-iters null = tire asset recommendation; thickness null = the tire asset's shellThickness (Sherp 8 mm, jeep 10 mm) else its bands; the pressure is clamped into the vehicle's CTIS envelope (Sherp: 2.1 psi).
